question: Which cities were ranked among the safest for women according to the National Annual Report and Index on Women's Safety (NARI) 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kohima and Mumbai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kohima and Mumbai were ranked among the safest cities for women, according to the National Annual Report and Index on Women's Safety (NARI) 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The NARI report highlighted Kohima, Vishakhapatnam, Bhubaneswar, Aizawl, Gangtok, Itanagara, and Mumbai as leading cities in terms of women’s safety.**
 
• **Cities like Ranchi, Srinagar, Kolkata, Delhi, Faridabad, Patna, and Jaipur ranked at the lowest in terms of safety.**
 
• **The report was based on a survey of 12,770 women across 31 nations, and safety scores were categorized across various benchmarks.**
 
• **Safety perceptions dropped significantly at night, especially for public transport or recreational places.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• National Annual Report and Index on Women's Safety (NARI)__

 __
 
• The NARI index is a comprehensive survey that ranks cities based on safety measures, awareness, and the challenges women face across the globe.
 
 
 
• National Commission for Women (NCW)__
 
 
• NCW launched the NARI report and emphasized the importance of comprehensive safety, including physical, psychological, and digital security for women.
